Firefox automatically checks the spelling of words that you enter in text boxes. As soon as you finish typing a word, it is checked against the words in the installed dictionary. If the word is not found in the dictionary, it will be underlined in red, as in the following example:
;[[Image:05675f3d603e2607555817580ba1c0c2-1271792700-577-1.png]]
{note}
'''Note:'''
* Automatic spell-checking is only turned on for text boxes containing '''more than one line''', where you can enter as much text as you want.
* Not all locales come with a dictionary installed due to licensing reasons.
{/note}

<!-- L10N: If your locale has no spell checking dictionary included, feel free to rearrange the sections, e.g. Adding dictionaries > Correcting misspelled words > Switching dictionaries > Disabling automatic spell-checking > Removing a word you have accidentally added -->
= Disable automatic spell-checking =
By default, Firefox is configured to automatically check spelling. You can turn it off in the [[Template:optionsorpreferences]] window:
# [[T:optionspreferences]]
# {for not fx152}In the {menu General} panel, go to the {for fx151}''Spell check'' section{/for}{for not fx151} ''Language'' section{/for}{/for}{for fx152}Select {menu Languages} on the left and go down to the ''Spell check'' section{/for}.
# Uncheck '''Check your spelling as you type'''.
#;{for fx152}[[Image:Fx152settings-SpellCheck]]{/for}{for not fx152}{for fx151}[[Image:Fx151settings-SpellCheck]]{/for}{for not fx151}[[Image:Fx140ESRsettings-Language]]{/for}{/for}
# [[T:closeOptionsPreferences]]
{for linux}{note}'''Note:''' Some options may not appear in the preferences window in custom builds of Firefox.{/note}{/for}<!-- Is this a bug in the custom build? (i.e. Ubuntu canonical - 1.0) -->

= Correct misspelled words =
When spell-checking is enabled, you can easily correct misspelled words. To correct the misspelled word, [[Template:contextmenu]] on it and select one of the suggested words at the top of the menu.
;[[Image:05675f3d603e2607555817580ba1c0c2-1271792700-577-3.png]]
If none of the suggested words is appropriate, you must manually edit it. If you are sure the word is spelled correctly, you can add it to the dictionary. To add a word to the dictionary, [[Template:contextmenu]] on it, and select {menu Add to Dictionary}.
{note}'''Note:''' Added words apply to all your dictionaries.{/note}

= Add dictionaries =
You can install other dictionaries as necessary.
# [[T:contextmenu]] in any text box containing more than one line.
# Select {menu Languages}.
# Select {menu Add dictionaries}.
#;[[Image:05675f3d603e2607555817580ba1c0c2-1271792700-577-4.png]]
# The [https://addons.mozilla.org/firefox/language-tools/ Dictionaries & Language Packs] page is displayed. Find a dictionary on the list and click on it to open its page.
# Click the {button Add to Firefox} button on the page that opens. When the warning panel appears, click {button Add} to allow the installation.
#;[[Image:addon doorhanger 57]]

= Switch dictionaries =
After the dictionary is installed, you can switch to it, as needed. To switch to a different installed dictionary, [[Template:contextmenu]] in a multi-line field, select {menu Languages}, then select the dictionary you want to use.
;[[Image:05675f3d603e2607555817580ba1c0c2-1271792700-577-6.png]]
You can select more than one dictionary. The spell checker will also check spelling against multiple languages.

= Remove a word you have accidentally added =
# [[T:profileFolder]]
# [[T:closeFirefox]]
# Open the file {filepath persdict.dat} in a text editor{for win} (such as '''WordPad'''){/for}{for mac} (such as '''Pages'''){/for}{for linux} (such as '''Calligra Words'''){/for}.
# In the text editor, each word you've added is on a separate line. Remove the line, containing the word you wish to remove.
# Click the {menu File} menu and select {menu Save}, to save your work.
{note}'''Note:''' Removed words apply to all your dictionaries.{/note}
